fixed_scope.calibration: Exactly32 DIV2K training images0001..0032. Center native128 crop, floatRGB/255, avg_pool2d(2) to64x64. Freeze preprocessing/order/data hashes. No per-image normalization or later centering beyond fixed mean.5. Do not drop unreadable/failed images; fail or retain incomplete state.
fixed_scope.ensemble: Uniform finite ensemble over32 complete RGB images with equal pixel/channel weights; equivalently96 fixed vectors formed by32 images times3 channels. This equivalence is algebraic, not a claim of96 iid draws.
fixed_scope.models: Reuse12 already-fixed linear operators:3 phase geometries[0,0],[0,1],[0,2] times methodsrbf/fixed_rf times sigma3/10. nu=1e-4, mean.5, target shave4=P3136. No new kernels, trained models or GPU work.
fixed_scope.operator_reference: Use W_full from old image0801 operator outputs, not0801 pixels. Before calibration, verify matching-arm W_full/frequencyB/coordinates/indices across0801/0802: exact shapes/orders, finite state, max absolute numeric difference<=1e-14; integer indices exactly equal. If failed, do not average or choose a convenient operator. Preserve checks/hashes and stop this arm/cohort.
fixed_scope.notation_warning: Old control source uses W for full4096-by512 linear response; this plan calls it W_a. T is the3136-by4096 target crop. B_a=T W_a is the cropped response. Random frequency matrix is separately named Omega; do not confuse it with a reconstruction response.

exact_common_law_calculation.vectors: For image i, X_i in R^(4096 x3), Z_i=X_i-.5. A_g in R^(512 x4096) is the fixed point sampler including duplicate rows. T crops indicesx,y=4..59. W_a in R^(4096 x512) maps centered observations to centered full output. D_a=T W_a A_g-T; clean target residualE_ai=D_a Z_i.
exact_common_law_calculation.risk: Rcal(a)=(1/(32*3*P))sum_i ||D_a Z_i||_F^2 +nu||T W_a||_F^2/P. First term is the exact mean squared bias under the chosen finite ensemble. Second term is the exact expected observation-noise error for3 equally weighted channels. No extra factor3 or32 belongs in the second term.
exact_common_law_calculation.second_moment: Gcal=(1/96)sum_{i=1..32,c=1..3} z_ic z_ic^T. Do not subtract the calibration mean: this is the uncentered second moment relative to the fixed predictor mean.5. It includes any nonzero image/channel mean residual. Then Rcal=tr(D_a Gcal D_a^T)/P+nu||T W_a||_F^2/P.
exact_common_law_calculation.low_rank: U=[z_11,z_12,z_13,...,z_32,3]/sqrt96 in R^(4096 x96); Gcal=U U^T and rank<=96. Rcal=||D_a U||_F^2/P+nu||T W_a||_F^2/P. This avoids constructing a4096x4096 moment matrix. Compute the equivalent direct per-image/RGB residual sum as an implementation identity.
exact_common_law_calculation.noise_assumptions: Gaussianity of image or noise is unnecessary for this second-moment identity. Require observation noise mean0, covariance nu I per channel and independent of the clean image. Cross-channel correlations do not affect this per-channel squared-error expectation for a shared channelwise operator; they would matter for any uncertainty analysis or cross-channel estimator.
exact_common_law_calculation.law_meaning: One hypothetical deployment draws one of these32 fixed images uniformly and adds new noise with the stated covariance. Rcal is the exact ensemble expected MSE for a fixed linear estimator under that artificial common law. The calculation is not an estimate with96 iid sampling confidence intervals.
exact_common_law_calculation.population_boundary: No Gaussian or stationary natural-image assumption is needed, but transfer from this finite calibration ensemble to other images is not guaranteed.32 training images and96 channel vectors do not yield a target-population CI. The disjoint IDs prevent direct target reuse; they do not create a randomly sampled representative population.
exact_common_law_calculation.cross_method_fairness: The same Gcal and preprocessing is used for every arm. Comparing self-prior posterior variances used different model laws; common-law risk removes that comparison mismatch but retains calibration-distribution limitations.

static_recommendations.groups: Predeclare three groups of4 arms at fixed geometry; four groups of3 geometries at fixed method and sigma; and one global group ofall12 arms. Preserve full risk tables even when recommended winners coincide.
static_recommendations.rule: Within each group compute rmin=min Rcal. Tie set={a:Rcal(a)<=rmin+1e-12} using absolute MSE tolerance, no implicit relative np.isclose. Choose the lexicographically first canonical key (phase tuple,method string,sigma integer), with all keys/order frozen before dev truth. Report all tied arms plus selected arm and margin.
static_recommendations.meaning: Recommendations are static functions of the calibration ensemble and fixed operators. No target-y/image-adaptive prior estimation, no per-target sigma choice, and no calibrated uncertainty model is built.
static_recommendations.sigma3_case: If every group favors sigma3, interpret it as this finite calibration law favoring a static smooth prior/linear rule atnu1e-4 and this geometry. It is neither image-specific spectral adaptation nor evidence that sigma3 generally wins or trains original FF better.
static_recommendations.geometry_cost: All three candidate geometries have512 scalar measurements per channel, but unique sites differ. Static geometry recommendation is for future acquisition; retrospectively scoring all saved geometries incurred all their observations. Report calibration/evaluation and prospective per-target acquisition costs separately.

freeze_before_development_scoring.required_freeze: Before loading any0801/0802 clean/truth or old scores in this run, freeze hashes for analysis plan, execution source/protocol, all32 calibration files/preprocessing, all12 reference W/Omega/coords/indices, cross-image operator checks, per-image/channel residual summaries, risk table and all static recommendations/tie groups. Store a complete manifest and itsSHA; no scoring with missing/failed arms or images.
freeze_before_development_scoring.score_only_after: After complete SHA freeze, load the two already-seen development truths and old saved observations/scores. Evaluate recommendations and all retained arms. No recommendation edits after scoring; preserve counterexamples. If numerical/preprocessing defects require a new version, archive this cohort and use a new execution root.
freeze_before_development_scoring.history_boundary: 0801/0802 and old rankings have already informed development. A new in-run freeze prevents further tuning but does not make these images unseen or turn the analysis into a blind/confirmatory test.
freeze_before_development_scoring.no_new_training: No GPU launch, retraining, new model or wider experiment is part of this stage.

development_evaluation.primary_target: For each dev image and arm, expected fixed-truth fresh-noise risk Rdev_i(a)=||D_a Z_i||_F^2/(3P)+nu||T W_a||_F^2/P. This is the appropriate primary comparison against Rcal. Also report saved realized raw MSE separately; its stochastic noise and cross term need not rank like expected risk.
development_evaluation.full_pair_signs: Compute all66 unordered arm pairs for each dev image, retaining cal gap, dev expected gap and realized gap. Include scoped comparisons within every recommendation group. Use fixed absolute1e-12 tie tolerance. Count strict concordance/strict discordance, cal ties, dev ties and missing/failed pairs separately; never exclude disagreement pairs or treat cal ties as correct strict predictions.
development_evaluation.misrank: A strict cal ordering and opposite strict dev expected ordering is a misrank. Report numerator/denominator for all strict-comparable pairs and each group, plus the full pair table. For two images this is descriptive, not a binomial population reliability estimate.
development_evaluation.oracle_regret: For each group and each dev image, selected static arm regret=Rdev_i(selected_cal)-min_{a in group}Rdev_i(a). Offline oracle reads truth only afterfreeze. Also report realized-MSE regret against its separate noisy oracle; do not mix the two estimands. Keep absolute MSE regret primary, worst-case across2 images and all counterexamples. Relative regret may be secondary with a declared denominator floor.
development_evaluation.selection_failures: Report whether the static recommendation is group-optimal within tolerance for each image, and severe losses in both MSE and PSNR as descriptive quantities. No hypothesis/significance conclusion from2 images; do not tune severity cutoffs after seeing scores.
development_evaluation.baseline_explanations: Compare risk-gap signs/ranks against model self-prior vbar ranks, and annotate the same nearest-distance phase01/02 pair and distinct covariance-rank claims. Self-prior vbar is a descriptive comparator, not a common-law true-risk estimator. If common-law signs align better than self-prior signs on these two images, call it local explanatory alignment, not validated selection effectiveness.
development_evaluation.bias_noise_components: Keep cal bias/noise and dev bias/noise/cross separately. A rank difference may be explained by calibrated bias, noise amplification, transfer mismatch or a single realized noise draw. Rank correlation alone is insufficient; risk margins/regret and full sign counterexamples are required.
development_evaluation.scope_of_prediction: Only these fixed linear responses are scored. The original FF has nonlinear hidden layers, trained weights/biases, optimizer and finite-step effects. Rcal for fixedRF/RBF cannot predict the original FF training algorithm or test generalization, even with the same initial frequency matrix.

existing_counterexamples_and_geometry.nearest_distance: phase01 andphase02 have identical full nearest-distance distributions on the integer shave4 target, including horizontal distances0/1 equally and the same vertical grid. Any risk difference therefore requires more than that scalar distribution; joint observation correlations, two-neighbor structure and signal bias remain possible explanations.
existing_counterexamples_and_geometry.rank: The8-point stationary covariance-family rank result addresses unknown-prior/risk-gap identification from independent latent realizations. It is not a causal explanation of64x64 known-kernel reconstruction, nor a universal phase recommendation.
existing_counterexamples_and_geometry.self_prior: Low own-kernel posterior variance can coexist with high true fixed-image bias or noise risk. Shared calibrated second moment makes risks comparable under one declared law, but does not make calibration transferable automatically.
existing_counterexamples_and_geometry.scientific_goal: Separate sampling for fixed-prior reconstruction from sampling for unknown-prior/candidate selection. A possible later alias-block or joint-correlation tradeoff must have explicit common operator/law and equal costs; present calibration stage does not derive or validate that theory.

numerical_cost_failure_controls.precision: Use existingfloat64 W and float64 residual/noise-risk accumulation, no new linear solve or changed regularization. Compare direct per-image average with low-rank trace expression under declared scale-aware floating tolerance. Exact algebra is the guarantee; floating sums need retained finite/residual diagnostics.
numerical_cost_failure_controls.scales: P3136,C3,I32,n4096,m512. Correct normalization is1/(I*C*P) for residual bias,nu/P for cropped response Frobenius squared. Target mask/channel order/mean mismatch is a protocol failure.
numerical_cost_failure_controls.identity_tolerance: Predeclare abs difference<=1e-10*max(1,|risk|) for direct-versus-low-rank risk identity and retain both raw values. Tie tolerance1e-12 can be smaller than a worst numerical bound; if numerical error could change a tie decision, retain the ambiguity and do not claim a mathematically certified strict winner.
numerical_cost_failure_controls.cost: Record calibration image load/preprocess, operator load/verification, observation extraction, all12 residual matrix products, Frobenius noise term, saving/freezing, and scoring separately; wall/processCPU/peakRSS. U is4096x96 about3.15MBfloat64; avoid fullGcal about134MB. Calibration data and computation are additional selection resources, not free.
numerical_cost_failure_controls.failure: Missing calibration file/arm, nonfinite values, operator mismatch>1e-14, preprocessing/shape inconsistency, failed identity, incompletefreeze or postscore recommendation change: stop or retain incomplete/failed records. Do not drop offending images, modify the fixed mean or choose another law after dev scoring.

novelty_and_next_scientific_gate.classic_coverage: This is an empirical second-moment bias-variance risk calculation and empirical-risk minimization over finitely many fixed linear estimators. Common-law comparison, static calibration, experimental-design covariance objectives and partial-identification ranking are classical. No A-conference new-method claim follows from this calculation.
novelty_and_next_scientific_gate.what_success_means: Successful calculation verifies scaling/implementation and may explain why earlier self-prior uncertainty or distance-only arguments did not predict these fixed-linear development rankings. It can provide a candidate static baseline to freeze for later study.
novelty_and_next_scientific_gate.what_success_does_not_mean: It does not establish image-adaptive selection, original FF training effectiveness, target population reliability, test generalization or novel adaptation-versus-reconstruction theory.
novelty_and_next_scientific_gate.next_empirical_gate: Any effectiveness claim requires a materially larger cohort not used to develop this selection rule, after freezing calibration law/candidates/budgets/tie policy, with full pair failures, oracle regret and baseline costs. Prior exposure elsewhere in research must be disclosed; rule-unseen is not automatically globally-unseen.
novelty_and_next_scientific_gate.next_A_analysis_gate: For an A-class analytical route, empirical replication alone may still be insufficient: need a task-specific nontrivial sharp relation or countervailing tradeoff between reconstruction and learning/selecting a spectral prior, explicit assumptions and matched-cost interventions, with closest classical theory checked. More correlations on the same32 calibration images do not cross either gate.
novelty_and_next_scientific_gate.current_action: Finish this bounded common-law control first. This plan authorizes no new GPU/model run and no additional experiments beyond calibration and already-seen dev scoring.
